clue.text: Such slopes beat a rider

parts.note: inclines in the road, such as humps put in to slow traffic, are the kind that get the better of someone riding over them

explanation.surface: A cyclist or horseman is defeated by steep hills.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is a cryptic hint: inclines that can throw or defeat a rider.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramps are artificial inclines, which slow or unseat whoever rides over them.

clue.text: For printing grainy photographs?

parts.note: the material is made from a grain crop, so it is jokingly what you would print grainy pictures on

explanation.surface: A question about what to print low-quality photos on.
explanation.definitionFit: This thin edible sheet is made from a cereal plant, so it is literally grainy writing material.

clue.text: A dotty means of communicating!

parts.note: dotty suggests crazy, but the code here is built of dots and dashes

explanation.definitionFit: Samuel Morse's telegraph code transmits letters as dots and dashes.

clue.text: Severed to free a dock-worker

indicators.note: to free the letters is to release them from their order and rearrange them

explanation.surface: A docker is cut loose.
explanation.definitionFit: A stevedore loads and unloads ships at port.

clue.text: Pulverise material that's noxious

indicators.note: material here is stuff to be reworked, so the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone grinding a substance finds it gives off something nasty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pulverise' looks like the anagram signal, but it is the fodder; 'material' tells you to reshape its letters. 'that's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something noxious is offensive and disgusting, which is what repulsive means.

clue.text: Puff rising round a rich turnover or biscuit

indicators.note: the reversed puff goes round the other pieces, enclosing them
in a down clue rising means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a puff is a breath of air

indicators.note: turnover means the word before it is turned back to front

parts.note: rich food is fat

explanation.surface: A breath of steam rises around a fatty pastry or cookie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns AIR into RIA and 'turnover' turns FAT into TAF; A and TAF sit inside RIA. 'turnover' poses as a pastry; 'or' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratafia is a small almond-flavoured cookie.

clue.text: Stops for ages

explanation.definitionFit: A full stop is called a period in America; and historical eras are periods.

clue.text: Lake containing a small variety of fish

indicators.note: the lake word containing the other means it holds it inside

parts.note: a loch is a Scottish lake

explanation.surface: A lake is home to a minor species of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Loaches are small freshwater fish of the carp order.

clue.text: Not in good shape — so tense

definitions.meaning: a grammatical tense for ongoing past actions

explanation.definitionFit: Something flawed is not perfect; and the grammatical past continuous is called the imperfect tense.

clue.text: Always start yelling, that's all

parts.note: ever means always

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Constantly shouting is all someone does.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' is a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Every means each and all of a group.

clue.text: Woodman finding a bird trapped in a carrier

indicators.note: something trapped in another is held within it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a carter carries goods by cart
a pen is a female swan

explanation.surface: A lumberjack discovers a bird caught inside a delivery vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: PEN, the female swan, is a crossword favourite; 'finding' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpenter works with timber, so he is a craftsman in wood.

clue.text: When in drink a representative can be generous

indicators.note: one piece being in the other means it sits inside it

parts.note: ale is a beer
MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected representative

explanation.surface: A politician becomes open-handed after a few drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A generous helping is a plentiful or abundant one.

clue.text: The City's into convenience food share

indicators.note: the City going into the food means it is placed inside it

parts.note: a pie is a ready-made meal
EC is the postcode area for the City of London; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: London's financial district has taken to sharing ready meals.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, whose postcodes begin EC.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece is a portion or slice, a share of the whole.

clue.text: Reckless writer after dope

indicators.note: the writer comes after the word for dope, so it follows it

parts.note: a dope is an idiot or fool
Thomas Hardy was an English novelist and poet

explanation.surface: A careless author follows a drug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' tempts as drugs, but here it means a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: Being reckless means taking rash risks, which is foolhardy behaviour.

clue.text: It's quiet, and therefore the French make a feature of the garden

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
ergo is Latin for therefore
la is a French word for the

explanation.surface: Something calm and logical, the French say, makes for a garden highlight.
explanation.definitionFit: A pergola is an arbour of posts and trellis covered in climbers, a common garden structure.

clue.text: Touching outcry — outcry about a North American

parts.note: re means touching or concerning
a din is a loud noise

indicators.note: the second noise goes about the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a din is a racket

explanation.surface: A moving protest about an American.
explanation.definitionFit: This old and now offensive term was used for an indigenous person of the Americas.

clue.text: Follow to gain one's end

definitions.meaning: to come after, as one monarch after another

explanation.definitionFit: One heir takes over after another; and a person who wins through has attained the goal they wanted.

clue.text: Heavenly Spanish article acquired in Castile possibly

indicators.note: acquired in means taken inside, so the article goes within the reshuffled letters
possibly signals another arrangement of the place name

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A divine Spanish item was obtained in a Spanish region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges CASTILE as CESTIAL, and EL goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Celestial means relating to the sky or the heavens.

clue.text: Project for which the cost is five hundred

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
a charge is a fee or price

explanation.surface: A scheme whose price is five hundred.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the clue as saying the charge is D; 'for which the' is link material.
explanation.definitionFit: To project something is to throw or shoot it out, as a gun discharges a shell.

clue.text: Correct to change gear?

definitions.meaning: read whimsically as clothe again, putting on fresh clothing

explanation.definitionFit: To put a wrong right is to remedy it; and to put on clothes again, new gear, is re-dress.

clue.text: A little boy holding up business

indicators.note: the boy holding the rest means it surrounds them

parts.note: a son is a boy
CO is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A small child stalls a firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A soupçon is a tiny trace or hint of something.

clue.text: About least affected, so makes report

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: affected means artificially altered, so the letters of the word beside it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Being the least pretentious person helps one tell a story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' rearranges LEAST to LATES, which follows RE; 'so makes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate something is to tell or narrate it, as in a report.

clue.text: Engineers about to join up and train

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: about here means turned around and reordered, so the letters of the synonym are rearranged

parts.note: to unite is to join together

explanation.surface: Soldiers are set to enlist and drill.
explanation.walkthrough: An indirect anagram: 'about' rearranges UNITE, the synonym of 'join up', as TINUE; 'to' and 'and' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A retinue is a train of attendants following an important person.

clue.text: Identify the cause of weakness in grouse

definitions.meaning: track down a defect or flaw

explanation.definitionFit: Diagnosing a defect means locating the flaw; and to grouse is to criticise or carp.

clue.text: If ranchers carry money, it's foreign

indicators.note: the words carry the answer inside them, spanning the gap between them

explanation.surface: Cattle farmers with cash say it comes from abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: The franc was the currency of France and is still Switzerland's.

clue.text: Fast ships

explanation.definitionFit: Fleet of foot means swift; and a fleet is a body of naval vessels.

clue.text: Maintain silence about a learned person's collapse

indicators.note: the silence word goes about the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
an MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Keeping quiet about an academic's breakdown.
explanation.definitionFit: A smash is a crash or collapse, as of a business or a car.

clue.text: Dream constituents are prepared to do battle

indicators.note: the constituents of the word are its letters, taken apart and put together again

explanation.surface: Voters with a fantasy are ready to fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constituents' poses as voters but signals the rearrangement; 'are' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Armed forces carry weapons, ready for combat.

clue.text: Active, though turned 51 in years

indicators.note: the turned number goes in the word for years

parts.note: an age is a long span of years

indicators.note: turned means the Roman numeral is read backwards

parts.note: LI is 51 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone still lively despite having reached fifty-one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' makes LI into IL, which goes inside AGE; 'though' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Being active and lively on one's feet is being nimble.

clue.text: To study harder is necessary, he reasserts

parts.note: to con is to study or learn
firmer means more solid

explanation.surface: Someone insists that more strenuous study is required.
explanation.walkthrough: CON for study is an old sense; 'is necessary' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: One who reasserts something repeats and ratifies it, which is what a confirmer does.

clue.text: A woman caught over attitude of mind

parts.note: c is the cricket abbreviation for caught
on can mean over, as in a book on a subject
a stance is a position or outlook

explanation.surface: A lady's way of thinking has been found out.
explanation.definitionFit: Constance is a female first name.

clue.text: Establish oneself as a man of science

definitions.meaning: Sir Oliver ..., the British physicist known for radio work

explanation.definitionFit: To lodge is to become settled in a place; and Oliver Lodge was a physicist.
